pre_caption_prompt:

Please concisely specify the type of scenery shot (e.g., a landscape or cityscape scenery shot) in a single fluent paragraph.Also explain why there is no main subject, such as the focus being on the environment, atmosphere, or scale rather than a specific object. The final output should be a single, fluent paragraph describing the video, with no Markdown formatting or introductory text. pre_caption: This is a wide, high-angle cityscape scenery shot capturing a massive urban evacuation. The focus is on the overwhelming scale of the event and the atmosphere of controlled chaos, rather than on any single main subject. The scene is set in a dense downtown area where a green-watered river is crossed by several bridges. The streets and bridges are completely gridlocked with an immense traffic jam of cars, while vast crowds of people on foot swarm the sidewalks and riverbanks, all seemingly attempting to leave the city. On one of the central bridges, a white police car and several military-style trucks are visible, suggesting an official but tense response to the unfolding crisis.
